sources.name: Time Out - The best rooftop restaurants in London
names: Forza Wine at the National Theatre

quotes.The Culpeper: Ranked #1 of 15. 'An east end gastropub with a garden terrace up top that's open to diners from the spring, reopening April 17, 2026.' A green-fingered team harvests the roof garden for the menu; British woodland planting, silver birch and hazel; grilled baby leeks with romesco, grilled half chicken with chanterelles and black garlic.
quotes.Forza Wine: Ranked #2 of 15. Peckham. 'Cauliflower fritti and aioli never leaves the menu and is a must-order' - butterflied mackerel with fennel, mustard and dill; hake croquettes. The whole menu plus four Custardos is £130 for a group.
quotes.The Marksman: Ranked #3 of 15. 'A spruced-up roof terrace on the first floor of this cherished east London gastropub... On bright days, there's space for around 20 on a first come, first served basis.' Two-course Sunday lunch £38, three for £42. 254 Hackney Rd, E2 7SB.
quotes.Seabird: Ranked #4 of 15. 'A Mediterranean seafood menu on a hotel rooftop by the river' - dressed crab, fried calamari, whole tiger prawns with aioli, and an oyster list claiming to be London's longest. Oyster happy hour daily 3-6pm. 14th Floor, 40 Blackfriars Road, SE1 8NY.
quotes.FM Mangal: Ranked #5 of 15. 'A mini rooftop kebab escape on Camberwell's main drag' - a teeny tiny rooftop balcony above a Turkish grill; the house special platter with lamb; mains around £15. 54 Camberwell Church St, SE5 8QZ.
quotes.OMA: Ranked #6 of 15. 'So we might be stretching the definition of rooftop here' - a first-floor al fresco terrace over Borough Market. Labneh topped with crispy salt cod xo sauce, 'which may be the best £6 you can spend in London right now'.
quotes.Yasmin: Ranked #7 of 15. Sixth floor of the 1 Warwick members club in Soho. 'Large retractable shades will keep out the rain, and there are heaters if things get a little chilly.' Whipped sheep's cheese with hot honey; baharat duck skewers.
quotes.Forza Wine at the National Theatre: Ranked #8 of 15. 'A wonderful wraparound terrace with space for a whopping 70 guests' on the top floor of the National Theatre. Forza Taps, an outdoor walk-ins-only spot with wine on tap, runs just beneath it in summer.
quotes.Llama Inn: Ranked #9 of 15. Top floor of the Hoxton Shoreditch. Modern Peruvian - lamb empanada with aji chimichurri, cod with yuca cream. 1 Willow St, EC2A 4BH.
quotes.Kioku by Endo: Ranked #10 of 15. Sixth floor of The OWO. 'Dine inside, or, during the summer season plonk for the rooftop terrace' - views of Nelson's Column and Horse Guards Parade. Smoked yellowtail with aged caviar; chashu pork ramen ravioli.
quotes.Shanghai Me: Ranked #11 of 15. 28th floor of the London Hilton on Park Lane. 'You won't be able to get outside or onto a balcony, but the 28th floor views of Hyde Park should be enough.' 22 Park Lane, W1K 1BE.
quotes.Boundary Shoreditch: Ranked #12 of 15. 'Year-round panoramic city-wide views even in unclement weather (thank goodness for that glass orangery extension).' Grilled chermoula prawns, lamb koftes, octopus with sundried tomato. Open Tue-Sat 12-11pm.
quotes.Brooklands by Claude Bosi: Ranked #13 of 15. 'It scooped two Michelin stars mere months after opening.' A terrace at the top of The Peninsula with space for 26 covers; turbot with wild sea leeks, Lake District lamb. 'In case of weather emergencies, staff are more than happy to move you to a table back inside.'
quotes.The Lighterman: Ranked #14 of 15. 'It's not technically on the roof, but it's as good as' - a first-floor wraparound terrace over Granary Square, bordering the canal.
quotes.The Devonshire: Ranked #15 of 15. 'Space for 40 covers on the third floor of Soho's most hype-y gastropub... Bookings for this seasonal rooftop aren't available, so you'll just have to chance your luck.' 17 Denman St, W1D 7HW.

sources.name: Time Out - London's best riverside restaurants

quotes.The River Café: Ranked #1 of 16. 'Set back from the Thames Path, the River Cafe is a celeb in its own right, and something of an icon when it comes to riverside dining in the capital.' Prices called excruciating; the advice is a summer lunch on the terrace.
quotes.Towpath: Ranked #2 of 16. 'Breakfast on the towpath overlooking the Regent's Canal near Whitmore Bridge' - a self-consciously low-key cafe of dog-walkers, runners and cyclists, rustic hot lunches and light cakes.
quotes.Scott's Richmond: Ranked #6 of 16. 'The Twickenham outpost of storied Mayfair seafood spot Scott's... comes with a frankly gorgeous terrace which looks out over the Thames.' Opened 2022. Oysters, crab and caviar.
quotes.Darcie & May Green: Ranked #9 of 16. 'Moored on the Grand Union Canal outside Paddington Station... floating pieces of art designed by Sir Peter Blake.' A combined 50-metre upper deck.
quotes.Le Pont de la Tour: Ranked #10 of 16. 'Sweeping views of Tower Bridge and beyond' - a sought-after terrace, a brasserie-style Bar & Grill and a separate restaurant.
quotes.Crate Brewery: Ranked #11 of 16. 'A hip warehouse-style pizzeria-cum-brewery on the banks of the Lea' - arrive early, bag a riverside bench.
quotes.OXO Tower Restaurant: Ranked #12 of 16. Eighth-floor restaurant, brasserie and bar. 'Recently been taken over by the team who run the ever-popular Fallow, who will gradually make tweaks... It'll officially take over in 2027.'
quotes.Rick Stein Barnes: Ranked #14 of 16. 'Ask for a window table to make the most of the Thames-side vistas' - Cornish lobster, Indonesian seafood curry.
quotes.Swan at Shakespeare's Globe: Ranked #15 of 16. 'Bag a seat facing the window if you can - by night, the riverside aspect of St Paul's in all its illuminated glory is stunning.'
quotes.Skylon: Ranked #16 of 16. 'A fail-safe on the first floor of the Royal Festival Hall' - trout in champagne sauce, crab and prawn linguine.

sources.name: The Infatuation - Where To Eat & Drink By The Water In London
names: Forza Wine at the National Theatre

quotes.The River Café: 'It would be impossible not to include London's most famous riverside restaurant in this list because, really, this is where you want to be eating if you want a view of water in London.'
quotes.Towpath: 'A seasonal cafe for seasoned table grabbers'... 'pretty much entirely outside seating and one of London's most dopamine-inducing restaurants'. Come midweek: it gets busy.
quotes.Scott's Richmond: 'If you can't get a seat on the terrace, ask for a window table when booking.'
quotes.Forza Wine at the National Theatre: 'A large terrace that thrives on orange wine, rich garlic butter slathered on fancy toast, and groups of friends sharing inventive seasonal plates.'
quotes.Barge East: 'On a stretch of the canal in Hackney Wick, this towpath adventure land has a canoe hire station, a covered alfresco bar, a leafy garden with a little treehouse.' Whitepost Ln, E9 5EN.
quotes.Cafe Cecilia: 'Hugs the Regent's Canal'; best first thing at the weekend for a window table. 32 Andrews Rd, E8 4QF.
quotes.Canal: 'May masquerade as a modern European restaurant with radicchio and monkfish on the menu, but really it knows exactly what the people want.' 11b Woodfield Road, W9 2BA, Maida Hill.
quotes.Inis: A British-Irish daytime restaurant on Fish Island, Hackney Wick. 13 Rookwood Way, E3 2XT.

sources.name: The Rooftop Guide - 20+ Best Rooftop Restaurants in London

quotes.Alto by San Carlo: 'The main restaurant and bar comes with a fully retractable roof, so you can dine in the sun or under cover year-round and no matter the weather.' Plus an al fresco terrace and lounge bar. Mains about £20.
quotes.Angler: 'A Michelin-starred rooftop restaurant'... 'the bright outdoor terrace is heated and has a retractable roof, making it available no matter the weather.' Mains about £48; tasting menu £155.
quotes.SUSHISAMBA Heron Tower: 'Found on the 38th and 39th floor of the Heron Tower... a very stylish indoor dining room with floor-to-ceiling panoramic glass windows, as well as two outdoor terraces.' Large plates about £50.
quotes.Seabird: 'Perched 14 floors up at the fantastic hotel The Hoxton in Southwark.' Large plates about £40.
quotes.Boundary Shoreditch: 'Both inside restaurant and a lovely rooftop garden, surrounded by shrubbery... Boundary also has a heated rooftop orangery.' Big plates about £30.
quotes.Coq d'Argent: '80ft above the ground'... 'The rooftop is open year-round, with heaters and plaits of wool making for a cosy terrace experience during winter.' Mains about £35.
quotes.Smiths of Smithfield: 'Four floors... it all ends with the top floor No.3 Rooftop Restaurant and outside terrace. With panoramic windows inside, and heaters on the outside terrace, this is a year-round venue.'
quotes.Mercer Roof Terrace: 'A cosy indoor restaurant with floor-to-ceiling glass doors opens up to an open-air terrace.' Three-course dinner £35. On top of the Vintry & Mercer hotel.
quotes.Aviary: 'Part interior dining room and part spacious al fresco terrace... get comfy in the beautiful rooftop igloos during the colder months.' On the Montcalm Royal London House, Finsbury Square. Mains about £30.
quotes.The Rooftop St. James: 'Both indoor and outdoor seating, and the terrace comes with heaters so it is available year-round.' Seventh floor of The Trafalgar St. James. Mains about £25.
quotes.Bōkan: 'Covering the top floors of the Novotel London Canary Wharf... the more filling option is the 37th floor Bokan 37 Restaurant.' Two courses £49, three £59, seven £99.
quotes.Wagtail: 'A 9th floor fine dining restaurant with two private terraces... and a 10th floor rooftop terrace and bar.' Mains about £30.
quotes.Madison: 'On top of the One New Change building, right across St. Paul.' Two courses £45.
quotes.CÉ LA VI: 'The 17th and 18th floor of Paddington Square... West London's highest rooftop destination.' Mains £30-60.
quotes.Kitty Hawk: 'Perched on top of the Page8 Hotel, between Trafalgar Square and Covent Garden.' Mains about £30.
quotes.1 Leicester Square Rooftop: Indoor and outdoor seating with floor-to-ceiling windows; open from breakfast to late.
quotes.8 at The Londoner: Eighth floor of The Londoner on Leicester Square; a bar, the Shima Garden and a terrace. Plates about £20.
quotes.KASO Rooftop Bar & Kitchen: On top of One Hundred Shoreditch; interior lounge plus outdoor terrace. Grill and pita about £20.
quotes.Stanley's Rooftop Bar: 'This fifth-floor retreat offers... discreet heating, and a retractable roof that ensures comfort whatever the season.' About 60 seats, on top of The Chesterfield Mayfair.
quotes.La'Yam Rooftop: 'The 8th floor of Kingsbourne House, directly on top of Holborn Station'; an open-air venue. Skewers £10, mezze platter £25.
quotes.The AMANO Rooftop: Seven floors above Russell Street in Covent Garden; indoor lounge plus outdoor terrace. Tapas about £8.
